page.title: Keep Tanzania's risk picture current
page.lead: Institutions enter new figures for the indicators they are responsible for, PMO reviewers check and approve them, and approved values flow straight into every map, table and area profile.

mode.demoTitle: Demo mode: data stays in this browser
mode.demoLead: No shared database is connected, so everything you enter is saved only on this device and never leaves it. Switch role to walk through the whole workflow: request an update as a PMO reviewer, send the figures as a sector officer (NBS in this demo), then approve them.

roleDesc.sector: Enter figures for your institution’s indicators and send them for PMO review.
roleDesc.pmo: Assign indicators, send requests, then review, approve, reject and revert. Your own entries can apply immediately.
roleDesc.admin: Full access: everything a PMO reviewer can do, plus managing people and their institutions.
roleDesc.ddrrc: Record the DRR arrangements of your council (Kondoa District in this demo) and send them to the regional committee for approval.
roleDesc.rdrrc: Record for Dodoma Region and its councils, and approve the councils’ records; the national committee approves the region’s.
roleDesc.ndrrc: Approve regional records and record for any area.

mode.live: Connected to the shared national database
mode.profileErrorTitle: Your account could not be loaded
mode.profileErrorLead: You are signed in, but your INFORM profile was not found or could not be read. Ask a PMO administrator to check your account, or sign out and try again.

signIn.title: Sign in to contribute
signIn.lead: The portal is for government officers and partners who maintain INFORM data. Anyone can browse approved changes; contributing needs an account.
signIn.point1: Every value carries its authority, dataset and author.
signIn.point2: Nothing reaches the public map until a PMO reviewer approves it.
signIn.point3: Every submission, approval and revert is kept in an audit trail.
signIn.linkHint: We will email you a one-time link, so no password is needed. It brings you straight back here.
signIn.passwordHint: Use the password set up by your administrator.
signIn.linkSentLead: We sent a sign-in link to {{email}}. Open it on this device to continue.

access.title: Want to contribute data?
access.lead: Contributor access is for officers of ministries, agencies and local government who hold data for INFORM indicators. Approval by the PMO Disaster Management Department keeps the public map trustworthy.
access.step1Title: Sign in with your work email
access.step1: New accounts start with read-only access.
access.step2Title: Ask to be linked to your institution
access.step2: Contact your PMO-DMD focal point with your institution. They give you the sector officer role and link your account to it.
access.step3: The indicators your institution is responsible for are listed with any open request. A PMO reviewer checks each submission before it reaches the map.
access.demoHint: In this demo, choose “Sector officer” or “PMO reviewer” above to try it.
access.signedInHint: Once your role is updated, reload this page to see the entry tools.
access.signedOutHint: Sign in above to get started.

people.emptyLead: People appear here after they first sign in.

committee.lead: What the disaster-management committees record, on the chain of the Risk Action Guide Book: the arrangements of each council and region, the statements people read under Know your risk, hazard event reports, and official warnings. Each record names what it rests on; the level above approves it; approved records show on the area profiles.

scope.ddrrc: You record for your council; the regional committee approves.
scope.rdrrc: You record for your region and its councils, and approve the councils’ records; the national committee approves the region’s.
scope.ndrrc: You record for any area, approve regional records and publish warnings.
scope.reviewer: PMO-DMD: you may record for any area, approve any record and publish warnings.
scope.none: Your account has no area yet. Ask an administrator to set the council or region you act for.

kindLead.drr: Whether the arrangements are in place: preparedness and response plan with its risk and vulnerability assessment, anticipatory action, trained response team, operations centre, DRR training of the committee; and how the committee functions: active, collaborating with stakeholders, involved in DRR issues. The engine scores the first five as DRM arrangements in place and the three criteria as committee functioning.
kindLead.guidance: The statement people read on the council’s profile: where the danger lies and what helps. Replace a guide-book row or add a new one, in English and Kiswahili.
kindLead.event: A hazard event that happened: when, what, and its impacts. The regional committee validates it.
kindLead.warning: An official warning as issued by TMA: hazard, level, areas and validity. It is published at once on the areas named and lifts on its end date.
kindLead.vc: The action library: for each INFORM indicator group (hazards, vulnerability and coping capacity), what reduces it and which sectors lead. PMO-DMD writes, the national committee reviews; the actions and the sectors appear on the detailed risk card and on every area where the group weighs most.

recordTitle.vc: Write or update the actions for a group

drr.lead: The first five arrangements (plan, assessment, trained team, centre, training) score the council's DRM arrangements; the three committee criteria score its functioning. Both enter the Core as institutional indicators and lower the lack of coping capacity of the council, its region and the country.

template.title: Work offline with a template
template.lead_one: Download one file with your {{count}} indicator and every area (the country, each region, each council), fill the new values in the spreadsheet of your choice, and upload it back. Rows without a new value are ignored; write n/a for no data; set value_type to score for 0 to 10 scores by the INFORM method and name the source.
template.lead_other: Download one file with your {{count}} indicators and every area (the country, each region, each council), fill the new values in the spreadsheet of your choice, and upload it back. Rows without a new value are ignored; write n/a for no data; set value_type to score for 0 to 10 scores by the INFORM method and name the source.

versions.title: Versions
versions.lead: A version is the state of the approved data at the end of a day on which something was approved. Compare two versions: the national value, the regions and councils whose risk changed, and where they are.
versions.none: No approved values yet, so the only version is the INFORM SADC 2024 baseline.
versions.unchanged: No area changed risk between these versions.
versions.map: Councils whose risk changed, on the current version's map

control.title: Data management
control.lead: One screen for the Office: who serves which indicator, how far each institution is, and where every live value comes from. Assignments and requests made here reach the institutions' own Indicators tab and inbox.

institutions.title: Institutions and their indicators
institutions.lead: Each institution with the indicators it is responsible for, its open requests and its submissions. Open a row to see the indicators and reach their entry sheets.
institutions.suggested_one: {{count}} unassigned indicator has this institution as its usual source
institutions.suggested_other: {{count}} unassigned indicators have this institution as their usual source
institutions.none: No institution holds an assignment yet.

actions.assignAll: Assign every unassigned indicator to its usual source

values.title: Where every live value comes from
values.lead: For each of the 32 indicator groups, the councils whose live value is the workbook’s, a Benchmark 2026 value, a value an institution entered through the portal, a value withheld after validation, or no value. A value approved through the portal replaces a benchmark or a withheld value for that council.
values.note: Withheld values failed validation against documented events; the Methodology page lists them.

request.title: Request updates from {{institution}}
request.lead: Every indicator assigned to the institution gets an update request; it appears in the institution's inbox and on its indicator list.
request.placeholder: What is needed, and for which period or survey?
request.error: The requests could not be sent

import.title: Import a filled collection tool
import.lead: Upload the Collection Tool or the Benchmark 2026 workbook as an institution returns it (xlsx), or a CSV template. Every indicator with a value becomes one submission in the review queue; nothing enters the model until it is approved.

management.title: Data management
management.lead: Each indicator group has a responsible institution and lead sectors. PMO-DMD assigns the indicators, requests updates, reviews what comes in and can enter figures for any institution with the source recorded; an approved value replaces the workbook's for that council and every level recomputes.
management.role: Signed in as {{role}}. Administrators and PMO reviewers manage the distribution.
management.note: Councils by the source of their live value: the INFORM SADC 2024 workbook, the Benchmark 2026 prepared from public datasets, values institutions entered through this portal, or values withheld after validation.

errors.decimals: Use at most one decimal, for example 6.5.
